mentions.name: MacDispatch
mentions.description: A macOS menu bar app that alerts users when apps start consuming excessive resources and draining the battery, helping diagnose resource-leaking Chrome tabs and misbehaving macOS services.
mentions.problem: Apps can silently use too many resources and drain the laptop battery without the user noticing.
